buff_desc_8112ready: <titleLeft>{{perk_displayname_Electrocute}}</titleLeft><mainText>Deal bonus damage when you hit an enemy champion with 3 attacks or spells in rapid succession.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
buff_desc_conqueror_enrage: <titleLeft>{{perk_displayname_Conqueror}}</titleLeft><mainText>This unit has additional adaptive force and is healing based on damage dealt to champions.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
buff_desc_conqueror_onh: <titleLeft>{{perk_displayname_Conqueror}}</titleLeft><mainText>This unit gains stacking bonus AD or AP as they damage enemy champions with new attacks and abilities. </mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
perk_long_desc_8112:
Hitting a champion with 3 separate attacks or abilities within @WindowDuration@s deals bonus adaptive damage.

Damage: @DamageBase@ - @DamageMax@ (+@BonusADRatio.-1@ bonus AD, +@APRatio.-1@ AP) damage.
Cooldown: @Cooldown@s

'We called them the Thunderlords, for to speak of their lightning was to invite disaster.'
perk_long_desc_8446:
Your third attack against towers deals [@BaseDamageMelee@ (+@HPRatioMelee.0 * 100@% max Health) Melee || @BaseDamageRanged@ (+@HPRatioRanged.0 * 100@% max Health) Ranged] bonus physical damage.

Cooldown: @CooldownSeconds@s
perk_long_desc_conqueror:
Basic attacks or spells that deal damage to an enemy champion grant 2 stacks of Conqueror for @BuffDuration@s, gaining @MinAdaptivePerStack@-@MaxAdaptivePerStack@ Adaptive Force per stack. Stacks up to @MaxStacks@ times. Ranged champions gain only 1 stack per basic attack.

When fully stacked, heal for @HealingPercent*100@% of the damage you deal to champions (@RangedHealingPercent*100@% for ranged champions).
perk_short_desc_8112: Hitting a champion with 3 separate attacks or abilities in @WindowDuration@s deals bonus adaptive damage.
perk_short_desc_8446: Your third attack against turrets deals bonus damage.
perk_short_desc_conqueror: Gain stacks of adaptive force when attacking enemy champions. After reaching @MaxStacks@ stacks, heal for a portion of damage you deal to champions.
perk_tooltip_8446:
Your third attack against towers deals @DamageCalc@ bonus physical damage.

Total bonus damage: @f1@
Total triggers: @f2@
Cooldown: @CooldownSeconds@s
